title: Blue Lightning Warrior Poses
description: A five-panel collage on a solid hot pink background featuring a female character with short silver hair in a dark blue armored outfit with a tail. She is shown in multiple dynamic action poses emitting bright blue electrical energy from her hands and body, with one central panel showing her stomping and creating a large blue energy burst.
prompt: A female character with short spiky silver hair wearing a form-fitting dark blue armored suit with shoulder pads, knee pads, and a long mechanical tail, shown in five different dynamic action poses against a solid magenta background. She has an angry expression with an open mouth, emitting bright blue lightning and electrical energy from her fists and body, one pose shows her stomping and creating a large blue energy explosion at her feet, in a detailed digital painting style.
